related.note: Both concern what kind of evidence the Nimitz Tic Tac encounter gives. Madden treats it as testimony from reliable witnesses, while the story calls it multisensory evidence.

plain: The Tic Tac case is a sighting of a white oval object, shaped like the mint, reported by military pilots. A researcher named James Madden uses it as an example of what evidence for such things usually looks like: the evidence is testimony, because seemingly very reliable pilots, Alex Dietrich and David Fravor, have said what they saw. His point is about how far the word of trustworthy witnesses can carry a claim, not a new account of the event.
